metadata.question: Does the snow cover in northwestern Pennsylvania increase between February 22, 2020, and March 1, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: I need to compare snow cover in northwestern Pennsylvania between two dates: - Date 1: February 22, 2020 - Date 2: March 1, 2020 - Location: Northwestern Pennsylvania (approximately 41.5°N, -80°W) - Collection: Landsat 8 or Sentinel-2 for snow detection (NDSI - Normalized Difference Snow Index) 2. Masking strategy: I should mask clouds to get clean snow observations. NDSI > 0.4 typically indicates snow. 3. Logic: - Calculate snow cover (NDSI > 0.4) for each date - Compare the snow-covered pixel counts or mean NDSI values - If Feb 22 snow area < March 1 snow area → Answer A (Yes, increased) - If Feb 22 snow area >= March 1 snow area → Answer B (No, did not increase) - Handle missing data (C1), no valid pixels (C2), or calculation failures (C3) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define northwestern Pennsylvania region const nwPA = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-80.5, 41.8], [-79.5, 41.8], [-79.5, 41.2], [-80.5, 41.2], [-80.5, 41.8]] ]); // Date ranges const date1Start = '2020-02-20'; const date1End = '2020-02-24'; const date2Start = '2020-02-28'; const date2End = '2020-03-03'; // Function to calculate snow cover function getSnowMetrics(startDate, endDate, label) { let col = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(nwPA) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .map(function(img) { // Cloud mask const cloudMask = img.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0); // Calculate NDSI (snow index) const ndsi = img.normalizedDifference(['SR_B3', 'SR_B6']).rename('NDSI'); return ndsi.updateMask(cloudMask); }); const imgCount = col.size().getInfo(); if (imgCount === 0) { console.log(`${label} Images: 0`); return null; } // Mosaic and calculate snow metrics const mosaic = col.median(); const snowMask = mosaic.gte(0.4); const snowPixels = mosaic.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: nwPA, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDSI').getInfo(); const meanNDSI = mosaic.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: nwPA, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDSI').getInfo(); const snowCover = snowMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: nwPA, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDSI').getInfo(); console.log(`${label} - Images: ${imgCount}, Valid Pixels: ${snowPixels}, Mean NDSI: ${meanNDSI !== null ? meanNDSI.toFixed(3) : 'null'}, Snow Pixels: ${snowCover !== null ? snowCover : 0}`); return { snowCover: snowCover !== null ? snowCover : 0, meanNDSI: meanNDSI, validPixels: snowPixels }; } // Get snow metrics for both periods const metrics1 = getSnowMetrics(date1Start, date1End, 'Feb 22, 2020'); const metrics2 = getSnowMetrics(date2Start, date2End, 'Mar 1, 2020'); // Validation and answer if (metrics1 === null) { console.log('No images for Feb 22 period'); console.log('C1'); return; } if (metrics2 === null) { console.log('No images for Mar 1 period'); console.log('C1'); return; } if (metrics1.validPixels === 0 || metrics2.validPixels === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after cloud masking'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (metrics1.meanNDSI === null || metrics2.meanNDSI === null) { console.log('Calculation failed: null result'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Compare snow cover console.log(`Snow Cover Comparison: Feb22=${metrics1.snowCover}, Mar1=${metrics2.snowCover}`); if (metrics2.snowCover > metrics1.snowCover) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
